clue.text: I acted in odd way to show where I am going in a car

definitions.text: show where I am going in a car

clue.text: Certainly I want to hug daughter

clue.text: Control bad credit

clue.text: Two Commanding Officers given a drink

clue.text: Fancy, but ultimately modest

clue.text: Compelled Chancellor of the Exchequer to get involved initially with car manufacturer

clue.text: Rattle might encourage one to play music

parts.words: Rattle might encourage one to play music

clue.text: Checks rules

clue.text: Worry it's wrong to wear women's clothing

clue.text: Carpenter, say — one who makes plenty of cuts

definitions.meaning: John Carpenter is a film-maker, so he is an example of one who calls the shots on set

definitions.text: one who makes plenty of cuts
definitions.meaning: a film-maker calls 'cut' at the end of each take and decides the final edit

explanation.walkthrough: 'Carpenter' looks like a woodworker but is the horror film-maker John Carpenter.
explanation.definitionFit: A film-maker who runs a shoot calls cut repeatedly, and John Carpenter is a well-known example.

clue.text: Dramatic divisions?

clue.text: Former lover with money and diamonds returned

clue.text: Panic when temperature drops, making a mistake

parts.note: terror is extreme fear or panic

clue.text: I'm to order skip

clue.text: Climbers might be here in large quantities

definitions.meaning: a huge pile, as in heaps of work

clue.text: Makes final payments and becomes calmer

definitions.meaning: to clear a bill or account is to pay it off
a nervous person or a restless sea calms down

clue.text: Pick on boy — one's very tiny

clue.text: Huge rock concert — can't I turn up?

clue.text: The French certainly have a bit of interest in time off work

clue.text: Be turning wicked

parts.note: to be is to live or exist

clue.text: Chair one found in class

parts.note: Nice is a city on the French Riviera
